    static final int MD = 998244353;
    static long[] ww, ww_;

    static long power(int a, int k) {
        long res = 1;
        long base = a % MD;
        int exp = k;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1)
                res = res * base % MD;
            base = base * base % MD;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    static void init() {
        ww = new long[21];
        ww_ = new long[21];
        for (int h = 0; h <= 20; h++) {
            ww[h] = power(3, (MD - 1) >> h);
            ww_[h] = power(3, MD - 1 - ((MD - 1) >> h));
        }
    }

    static void ntt(int[] aa, int n, boolean inverse) {
        for (int i = 1, j = 0; i < n; i++) {
            int b = n;
            do
                j ^= b >>= 1;
            while ((j & b) == 0);
            if (i < j) {
                int tmp = aa[i];
                aa[i] = aa[j];
                aa[j] = tmp;
            }
        }
        for (int h = 0, b; (b = 1 << h) < n; h++) {
            long w_ = inverse ? ww_[h + 1] : ww[h + 1];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i += b * 2) {
                long w = 1;
                for (int j = 0; j < b; j++) {
                    int l = i + j, r = l + b;
                    long u = aa[l], v = aa[r] * w;
                    aa[l] = (int) ((u + v) % MD);
